$comment: Language-agnostic conformance suite for the .workoutplan format. Every implementation should read each file under valid/ without error and reject each file under invalid/ with the stated error code.

valid.description: Absolute date with a UTC offset: a fixed instant, converted for display.
Non-canonical spellings a reader must accept ('run', 'minutes', 'rest'). Writers must not emit these, so this file is deliberately not valid against the schema.
Every alert type, on an activity that supports it.
Every goal type, including energy in the only place it is allowed.
Reserved `extensions` containers at every level must survive a read/write round-trip.
The smallest possible file: one goal workout, no date, no location.
Local wall-clock date: 07:30 in whatever time zone the athlete is in.

invalid.description: A range alert needs both bounds.
A swim-bike-run workout needs at least one leg.
A file with nothing to schedule.
Energy goals exist only in a single-goal workout - a WorkoutKit restriction.
A v1 reader must refuse a file from a future major version.
A custom workout without an activity.
A goal workout without a goal.
A pacer workout needs both a distance and a time.
Not parseable as JSON at all.
min above max. JSON Schema cannot compare two sibling values, so only a reader catches this.
An activity that is not in the vocabulary.
An alert type WorkoutKit has no equivalent for.
A goal type that does not exist.
A unit outside the vocabulary for that quantity.
`type` outside the four known workout shapes.
A block must repeat at least once.
